title: ItemSignment
description:
Allows you to sign an item using /sign command!
Allows color customisation and gradients.
body:
## It just allows you to sign items, that's it.
Features highly customizable messages, check the config for permissions. 

### Commands:

/sign - sign item in your hand (in case it's not signed)

/unsign - unsign item in your hand (in case you are the owner of the sign or are in creative mode)

/sign_all - sign every item in your inventory (if possible)

/unsign_all - unsign every item in your inventory (if possible)
